evidence.notes: Consistent Tailwind arbitrary-value utility system across all pages. Inter is the body/heading font; DM Mono / Fira Code monospace used for uppercase CTA labels and eyebrow text. Headings vary by page type between font-light (homepage), font-medium (service/listing/location), and font-semibold (agentic/contact/blog). Standard section padding is px-4 py-12 sm:px-6 sm:py-16 lg:px-8 lg:py-20. Cards consistently use rounded-2xl/rounded-xl with shadow-subtle or shadow-card and hover:shadow-card-hover. Hero sections carry large top padding (pt-32/36/40) implying a fixed overlay header not captured as a distinct section.
